text: Janto an Nulaaɗo, tuma nde Muusaa jaɓunoo yamiroore Joomi makko nden, o maakani yimɓe makko ɓen ka ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila'en himo anndintina ɓe neemaaji Alla ɗin e maɓɓe: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, annditee neema Alla on e mooɗon, tuma O daɗndunoo on e yimɓe Fir'awna ɓen e bone maɓɓe. Hiɓe meeɗinaynoo on lepte bonɗe, tawde hiɓe hirsiraynoo ɓiɗɓe mon worɓe ɓen fii wata on jibin wurtotooɓe e laamu fir'awna ngun, ɓe heddinira rewɓe mon ɓen fii jaasingol ɓe hoyna ɓe. Wonii e ɗen kuuɗe maɓɓe ɗon, jarrabuyee mon mawɗo e muññagol ɗum. Alla warjori on ngal muñal mon e on jarrabuyee, daɗndugol on e bone yimɓe fir'awna.
